body: {"id":"fd0c375b-cce9-4ed0-ad3b-9d839f0fa056","object":"chat.completion","created":1791707462,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{\"status\": \"ok\", \"term\": \"invalidate · 使失效\", \"meaning\": \"使其他核心持有的该缓存行副本变为无效，之后不能再直接使用，必须重新从内存或其他核心获取。\", \"qualifier\": \"\", \"details\": [{\"label\": \"句子结构\", \"text\": \"A write on one core 是主语，invalidates 是谓语，the copies held by the others 是宾语，表示一次写操作导致其他核心的副本失效。\"}, {\"label\": \"为何这样理解\", \"text\": \"下一句说那些核心的下一次读会 miss，说明失效后副本不再可用，这正是多核缓存一致性协议中的失效操作。\"}, {\"label\": \"其他用法\", \"text\": \"invalidate 在计算机领域常指使缓存、页表项或预测结果失效；日常英语中则指使某事物失去效力。\"}], \"missing\": \"\"}"},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":401,"completion_tokens":192,"total_tokens":593,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":0},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":0,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":401},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
